display.purpose: The h1 on each page. Playfair 500, tight tracking, capped at 13ch in the hero.

headline.purpose: Section titles, always preceded by an eyebrow label.

title.purpose: Pillar and category names, FAQ questions, cart line items, product-card titles.

body.purpose: Default prose at 1.62 line-height. Long-form caps at 70ch.

lead.purpose: Intro paragraph under a heading, at 68% ink, capped at 58ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked label in rose, prefixed with the sparkle mark. Top of the letterspacing ladder.

price.purpose: The euro figure in Playfair; the lev equivalent sits beneath it in Manrope 11px.

shadows.name: settle
shadows.purpose: A document laid on the page: the manufacturer's overlay sheet and the order-confirmation panel. Two uses only.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Genuinely detached objects: the story photographs and the toast. Three uses only.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The only glow in the system. Focused form fields, paired with a rose border, replacing the browser outline.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing curve. Every transition and keyframe animation in the system uses it.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Colour and border state changes on links, icon buttons, chips and fields.

motion.name: duration-nav-underline
motion.purpose: The nav rule wiping in from left (right: 100% to right: 0).

motion.name: duration-image
motion.purpose: Product and gallery image scale on hover (1.05 in cards, 1.06 on the PDP).

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveal: 10px rise with fade, triggered at 6% intersection. Product cards are deliberately excluded.

motion.name: hero-stagger
motion.purpose: Hero copy children enter on a rise, delayed 40ms then 80ms apart.

motion.name: float-y
motion.purpose: Decorative blossoms and petals drift 7px vertically with a 1.5deg tilt.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Brand marquee translate to -50%, paused on hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion cancels reveals, petals, blossoms and the hero entrance. Non-negotiable.

narrative.overview:
The page is a porcelain surface with an ink-black weight at either end and one blossom of colour between them. Everything rests on a near-white ground (porcelain, #FBF9F8) that is warm rather than clinical; the header floats over it on frosted glass, the footer and the Instagram band drop to near-black, and between those two anchors the content is allowed to breathe at 88px of vertical air per section.

The shrine is literal, not metaphorical decoration. Category tiles and the product-detail image are arched — fully round at the top, barely rounded at the base (999px 999px 6px 6px) — a torii silhouette that appears nowhere else in the system. A ✦ is the system's punctuation mark: it opens every eyebrow, sits in the centre of every divider, and rotates 45° when an FAQ opens. Brand branches, a crescent, a fan and a medallion are placed across the seams between sections, each motif used exactly once across the entire site, the way objects are placed at a shrine rather than repeated as a pattern. Only the small petal repeats, and its repetition is the deliberate exception.

Restraint carries the retail side. Product cards have no border, no background, no shadow and no lift — the cut-out bottle or sachet floats directly on the porcelain and grows 5% on hover, which is the only thing that moves. Where the rest of the category shouts with discount stickers and star ratings, this system states the sheet count, the origin and the price in a Playfair numeral and stops. The retired gold theme kept at assets/site-v1-gold.css is the anti-reference: warmth without metal, ceremony without luxury cliché.
keyCharacteristics: Porcelain ground, ink anchors, one accent — the rose never has to compete.
The arch (999px 999px 6px 6px) is the signature silhouette, reserved for category tiles and the PDP image.
✦ is the recurring mark: eyebrow prefix, divider centre, FAQ toggle.
Product cards are frameless and shadowless; the product itself is the card.
Decorative motifs cross section boundaries and are each used once.
Every motion is suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.
Playfair Display for anything that names or prices; Manrope for everything that instructs.

rules.name: The One Blossom Rule
rules.body: Rose and sakura together stay under roughly 10% of any screen. If a comp needs a second accent hue to work, the layout is wrong, not the palette.

rules.name: The Opacity Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Secondary text and borders are ink at reduced alpha, never a separate grey token. Never introduce #666, #999, or #E5E5E5.

rules.name: The Ink Inversion Rule
rules.body: On an ink ground, rose is replaced by sakura and body text becomes on-ink (rgba(250,244,242,.82)) — a warm off-white, never pure white. Only headings and links go to #fff.

rules.name: The Product Colour Rule
rules.body: Each catalog entry carries its own accent and tint (in assets/data.js) used solely for its badge and origin chip. That per-product colour never leaks into layout, buttons, or type.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Playfair names and prices; Manrope instructs and labels. A button, a chip, a form label or a spec value in Playfair is a defect — as is a price or a heading in Manrope.

rules.name: The Rose Italic Rule
rules.body: Emphasis inside a heading is achieved with <em>, which is italic and rose. No bold, no underline, no colour change without the italic.

rules.name: The Letterspacing Ladder Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking scales inversely with size: 11px → 0.26em, 12.5px → 0.1em, 10px → 0.2em. Uppercase text below 13px without tracking is wrong.

rules.name: The Two-Stop Rule
rules.body: The system breaks at 1080px and 760px. A new component adopts those stops rather than inventing its own.

rules.name: The Seam Container Rule
rules.body: Sections are overflow: hidden, so decoration that must cross a background boundary lives in its own zero-height .edge-deco container placed between the two sections, with overflow: visible. Below 1360px its right offset must go positive (right: 12px), because rotation widens the bounding box and a negative offset creates horizontal scroll.

rules.name: The Flat-Card Rule
rules.body: Product cards get no background, no border, no radius and no shadow. The cut-out product on porcelain is the card. Adding a container to a product card breaks the system.

rules.name: The Rationed Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element is a physical object — a photograph, a printed sheet, a notification. UI surfaces (panels, inputs, chips, tiles) use a hairline and a white fill instead.

rules.name: The Arch Reservation Rule
rules.body: 999px 999px x x belongs to category tiles and the PDP image. Do not apply it to cards, panels, buttons, or modals.

rules.name: The Round-Control Rule
rules.body: Anything the user clicks that is not a panel is a pill. Inputs and text areas are the documented exception at 6px.

dos: Do put emphasis inside headings in <em>, which renders italic and rose. That pairing is the house's signature gesture.
Do build hierarchy from ink at 68% and 44% opacity rather than introducing grey values.
Do use ✦ as the system's mark — eyebrow prefix, divider centre, FAQ toggle — and keep it in the accent colour.
Do separate sections by alternating porcelain and ivory grounds; reach for a rule only when a background change would be wrong.
Do swap rose for sakura and body text for on-ink on any ink-grounded surface.
Do place decoration outside the container and rely on body { overflow-x: hidden }, using .edge-deco whenever the motif must cross a seam.
Do guard every animation with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) — the existing code disables reveals, petals, blossoms and the hero entrance.
Do give new interactive controls the pill radius and Manrope uppercase at 0.12em.
Do hold the two breakpoints, 1080px and 760px.
Do clamp equivalent card fields to fixed heights so prices align across a frameless row.
donts: Don't put a border, background, shadow or lift on a product card. The frameless card is the deliberate centre of the system.
Don't use the arch (999px 999px x x) anywhere but category tiles and the product-detail image.
Don't reintroduce gold. assets/site-v1-gold.css is a retired theme kept only as a backup, and the palette's warmth must come from blush and cream.
Don't add a second accent hue. Per-product accent colours stay confined to badges and origin chips.
Don't set body text or backgrounds to pure #000 or #FFF on a light ground — the ground is porcelain and the ink is #141110. White is reserved for raised surfaces.
Don't set a heading, price, button, label or spec value in the wrong family; the Playfair/Manrope split is strict.
Don't add discount stickers, countdowns, star ratings or "customers also bought" rails. No review data exists, and the category's sale-wall vocabulary is the anti-reference.
Don't use shadows for UI surfaces — a hairline and a white fill say "raised" in this system.
Don't let a rotated decorative element keep a negative right offset below 1360px; it creates horizontal scroll.
Don't use the browser's default focus outline; focused fields take a rose border plus the 13% rose glow.
